440	who are already starting to rely more on the DNA issue, but in most of the poskim we see that they
441	do not rely on DNA at all, and they bring reasoning. And so, huh?
442	It helps the test, it helps. So that's it. I wanted to say that for added support we can bring DNA,
443	but they said no, not even as added support do they rely on it at all. It doesn't matter to me, even if it would help me support
444	my ruling, I don't bring DNA at all, they don't bring DNA. So I wanted to write in my responsa
445	in the conclusion: "and as added support I permit DNA, together with reasoning in the way of the Torah."
446	I changed my mind, I changed my mind and said: no, I permit reasoning in the way of the Torah,
447	with DNA added.
448	Is there a difference?
449	Of course.
450	Someone came to his rabbi and said to him, Rabbi, when I learn Torah, may I smoke?
451	The rabbi said to him no, you may not smoke, no, when you learn Torah you don't smoke.
452	He went to his friend and said, listen, I asked the rabbi, the rabbi said that when you learn Torah you don't smoke.
453	He said to him, why are you so, you don't know how to ask, come with me.
454	He went to the rabbi and said to him, Rabbi, when I smoke, may I learn Torah?
455	He said to him, of course, when you smoke you may learn Torah, but when you learn Torah you may not smoke.
456	Is there a difference?
457	It depends how you present it, it depends how you present it.
458	When you learn Torah you can't smoke, but when you smoke you can learn Torah. Why not?
459	It's permitted, no problem with that. What's the idea?
460	It depends how you phrase it. Here too, at the beginning I wrote that I permit DNA
461	plus added reasoning of Torah in the way of the Torah, and then I changed my mind and said: no, I permit reasoning in the way
462	of the Torah, and as added support one can add the DNA. What do you say?
463	Moshe, did you roll something today?
464	Did you roll or didn't you roll?
465	What is this, what, what, what?
466	And they open your closet and see everything arranged, the cassettes, everything with little rolls, everything
467	in order.
468	What, what, what?
469	A potato.
470	Both selling and playing innocent.
471	It's like they sell shoes and the like.
472	Like.
473	Behind the curtain are the real things.
474	Huh?
475	That's it.
476	Well, in any case, gentlemen, this is truly an interesting question.
477	By the way, if there are identical twins, it is impossible to test who the father is.
478	That is, if I have, say, an identical twin and they test me with his children, and they test
479	my children with his children, all come out that our children are all the same children. Why?
